title: Custom models
description: Choose a service and enter your API key to add models.
deleteDescription: Delete “{{name}}” and its {{count}} models? Existing conversations will remain.
missingKey: API key unavailable on this device; enter it again
emptyModels: No models yet. Edit to add models.
name: Endpoint name
discoveryHint: Fetch models using the current connection settings. No need to save first.
discardDescription: Unsaved connection and model changes will be lost.
discoveryEmpty: No models returned. You can add a model manually.
editorDescription: Choose a service and enter your API key to fetch models.
cloudHint: Connect to use models provided by the cloud.
recoveryDescription: Choose connections to recover and check their endpoints. Keys are restored by secure storage and are never displayed here.
recoveryUnavailable: Secure storage is unavailable. Unlock the system credential store and retry; restart the app after a timeout. After changing machines or system users, restore the original system credential store or configure keys again.
recoveryFailed: Recovery could not be confirmed. Original files and archives are retained. Refresh before retrying; restore a valid snapshot first if the configuration file is damaged.
recoverySuccess: Configuration restored. Select the recovered model and test its connection.
recoveryEmpty: No model connections can be restored automatically. Enter an API key again or choose a valid model file.
recoveryUnreadable: {{count}} archives cannot be restored automatically. Original data remains in secure storage. Use a valid model file or enter keys again.
recoveryCloud: Historical cloud credentials conflict. Reconnect to confirm your account; old tokens will not be restored automatically.
recoveryConfirmLegacy: Restore these old connections separately and retain the current configuration. Check the original endpoints and select the recovered model afterward.
recoveryConfirmSaved: Restore the valid snapshot to a new file and switch to it. Original files and archives will be retained. Check these endpoints.
